title: Onda Bella Cruises

services.name: Book a Cruise
services.desc: Onda Bella provides two-hour cruises for groups of up to six guests, running four times daily, seven days a week in Northport Harbor (Long Island). Escape to the charm of Northport Harbor with a two-hour private cruise for up to 6 guests aboard our quiet, all-electric boat. Whether you’re looking to relax, celebrate, swim, or paddleboard, this is your chance to experience the harbor your way. Enhance your outing with curated add-ons like artisanal charcuterie, fresh lobster rolls, wood-fired pizza, wine, craft beer, and more.
